# The window's refresh: the imports under way (the Metals page, the Overview); while the Metallurgy tab is open, the cost
# of the designs in service (the Regiments page).
DA_MET_window_numbers = {
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_MET_imports value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = DA_MET_import.Iron } change_variable = { which = DA_MET_imports value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = DA_MET_import.Copper } change_variable = { which = DA_MET_imports value = 1 } }

# The cost of the design in service of each row of the Regiments page: the n of its modifier DA_Cost_<kind>_<n> (added
# when a design is implemented; the variable DA_Cost_<kind> is the design being drawn). Upkeep and reinforcing cost
# +2.5%, reinforcing speed -1% a point.
DA_MET_regiment_numbers = {
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_MET_rg_cost_infantry value = 0 }

			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_enable_metallurgy_System_artificer } }

# The Alloy Library: the slot shown in the Alloy Forge (as the forge's own slot event, DA_alloys_events.1), and the forge.
DA_MET_select_C1 = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_MET_select.C1
	DA_initialize_alloy_variables = { DA_alloy_slot = C1 }
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_SCH_sub_met value = 2 }
		DA_SCH_alloy_slots = yes
		DA_SCH_refresh = yes
	}
}
